# omniddi_ipam_subnets (Data Source)

Lists IPAM subnets, optionally narrowed by a quick search, typed filters, tag filters and a scope node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omniddi_ipam_subnets" "lab" {
  search = "lab"
}

data "omniddi_ipam_subnets" "owned" {
  scope_node_id = 42

  filters = [
    { field = "owner", operator = "EQ", value = "netops" },
  ]

  tag_filters = {
    env = "prod"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Typed filters, all of which must match. `field` is a subnet column such as `name`, `networkAddress`, `prefixDisplay`, `status`, `vlan`, `owner` or `protocol`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `scope_node_id` (Number) Only list subnets at or below this container or family node.
- `search` (String) Case-insensitive substring matched against the name, network address, CIDR, protocol, VLAN, owner and description.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Only list subnets whose tags equal all of these values.

### Read-Only

- `subnets` (Attributes List) The matching subnets, ordered by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `field` (String) The field to filter on.
- `operator` (String) One of `EQ`, `NEQ`, `CONTAINS`, `NOT_CONTAINS`, `STARTS_WITH`, `ENDS_WITH`, `IS_NULL`, `NOT_NULL`.

Optional:

- `value` (String) The value to compare with.


<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Read-Only:

- `business_unit_id` (Number) Business unit the node belongs to (own or inherited).
- `cidr` (String) The network in CIDR notation, such as `10.0.0.0/24`.
- `created_on` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `has_children` (Boolean) Whether the node has child networks.
- `id` (Number) The node id. For a subnet this equals the `networks.id` used by DHCP resources.
- `name` (String) Node label. Defaults to the CIDR when no name was given.
- `owner` (String) Owner label.
- `parent_id` (Number) Id of the parent node.
- `prefix_length` (Number) Prefix length of the network.
- `protocol` (String) `IPv4` or `IPv6`.
- `status` (String) `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE` or `DEPRECATED`.
- `tags` (Map of String) Single-valued tags on the node (inherited values excluded when reported as inherited).
- `tags_list` (Map of List of String) Multi-valued tags on the node.
- `type` (String) Node type: `ROOT`, `FAMILY`, `CONTAINER` or `SUBNET`.
- `updated_on` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `vlan` (String) VLAN label.
